steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Water should taste like the sea.
Add spaghetti and cook until al dente according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, crush tomatoes by hand or blend briefly.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Add crushed garlic and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain pasta, reserving water. Add pasta to sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Toss over low heat until sauce clings to pasta. Top with basil.
Add water, olive oil, and salt to pressure cooker.
Add broken spaghetti on top (don't stir). Pour crushed tomatoes over pasta.
Seal lid, set to high pressure for 7 minutes.
Quick release pressure when timer beeps.
Stir well — sauce should coat pasta. If too thick, add water ¼ cup at a time.
Top with fresh basil and serve.
